speaker: Leonard
text: It wasn't awkward. Besides, what's the big deal? We dated, we, we stopped dating, and now we're both moving on.

speaker: Raj
text: It wasn't fun. By moving on, you mean she's going out with other men, and you spend the afternoon making 15th century soap with Wolowitz?

speaker: Sheldon
text: That was not 15th century soap. My God, those people need to learn. You can't just put ye old in front of anything you want and expect to get away with it. You're wearing modern underwear. Relatively modern.

speaker: Leonard
text: Can we please just go in? My chainmail's stuck in my underwear.

speaker: Leonard
text: Why, what are you wearing?

speaker: Sheldon
text: I fashioned historically accurate undergarments out of linen.

speaker: Leonard
text: You went out and bought linen?

speaker: Sheldon
text: Don't be silly. I borrowed one of your pillowcases.

speaker: Leonard
text: Borrowed?

speaker: Leonard
text: You know what? I'm happy that Penny's moving on. It gives me the freedom to move on myself.

speaker: Howard
text: Penny with a new guy, Trey Awkward. Are you saying that you've been holding back?

speaker: Leonard
text: Of course. Out of respect.

speaker: Howard
text: So, how do you explain the ten years before Penny? Who are you respecting then?

speaker: Leonard
text: Well, I've dated plenty of women. There was, uh, Joyce Kim, Leslie Winkle.

speaker: Sheldon
text: Notify the editors of the Oxford English Dictionary the word plenty has been redefined to mean two.

speaker: Leonard
text: Uh, what about that girl last year at Comic-Con? Why not?

speaker: Raj
text: Doesn't count. What happens in costume at Comic-Con stays at Comic-Con.

speaker: Howard
text: You're only saying that because of what happened to you.

speaker: Leonard
text: What happened to you?

speaker: Raj
text: N- n- nothing happened to me.

speaker: Howard
text: It wasn't your fault, Raj. He was dressed as a green Orion slave girl.

speaker: Raj
text: How did we get on me? We were mocking Leonard for not moving on. Dude, you have totally not moved on.

speaker: Leonard
text: Yes, I have. It's just a matter of actually making a date with someone. Well, there was Joyce Kim, but... She defected back to North Korea, so it's a little geographically undesirable.

speaker: Howard
text: Like who?

speaker: Raj
text: What about Leslie Winkle?

speaker: Sheldon
text: Oh, no. Her research methodology is sloppy, she's unjustifiably arrogant about loop quantum gravity, and to make matters worse, she's often mean to me.

speaker: Raj
text: Why?

speaker: Raj
text: I think she's smoking hot.

speaker: Howard
text: I'd hit that.

speaker: Sheldon
text: You'd hit particulate soil on a colloidal suspension. Mud.

speaker: Leonard
text: Look, I like Leslie, but she's not interested in dating as much as using men as tools for stress release.

speaker: Howard
text: So, be a tool. Go get yourself a little rebound stress release.

speaker: Raj
text: Technically, it would only be rebound if he and Penny had actually engaged in physical intimacy.

speaker: Howard
text: You mean like you and Richard the slave girl?

speaker: Raj
text: I bought him dinner, and we kissed once. That was it. And he told me his name was Kimberly.
